battle.name: 第二次巴勒斯坦大起義
battle.brief: 第二次巴勒斯坦大起義於2000年9月在耶路撒冷爆發，之後擴展至約旦河西岸及加薩地帶，成為列表所列的巴勒斯坦武裝衝突。英國陸軍於1858年列裝的恩菲爾德步槍（Enfield rifle），是符合年代限制的標準步兵武器。

kit.name: 恩菲爾德步槍
kit.history: 恩菲爾德步槍（Enfield rifle）自1858年起列裝英國陸軍，作為步兵部隊的標準制式步槍，配發給野戰部隊使用，並構成英軍步兵武器體系的核心。

countries: 主戰場分成西岸與加薩兩條地理相連、指揮卻分離的戰線。交戰一方是以色列國家、以色列國防軍及其政治領導層；另一方是巴勒斯坦民族權威機構，以及哈瑪斯、巴勒斯坦伊斯蘭聖戰組織等武裝團體，法塔赫旗下武裝也在部分戰區與哈瑪斯交火。埃及管理加薩一帶的邊境口岸並參與調解，約旦管理約旦河西岸東側的陸路通道；美國、歐洲國家與聯合國則提供外交框架、制裁工具和國際決議渠道。這些角色不能混寫成兩支單一國家軍隊：從二〇〇〇年至二〇〇五年，巴勒斯坦各武裝團體的指揮、補給與政治目標始終不一，以色列則由陸軍、海軍、空軍和情報單位提供縱深支援。
countriesEn: The main theater was divided into the West Bank and Gaza, two geographically connected fronts with separate chains of command. One belligerent was the State of Israel, the Israel Defense Forces, and its political leadership; the other comprised the Palestinian National Authority and armed Palestinian organizations such as Hamas and the Palestinian Islamic Jihad, while Fatah-linked forces also fought Hamas in several sectors. Egypt administered the border crossings around Gaza and participated in mediation, while Jordan managed land access along the eastern edge of the West Bank; the United States, European states, and the United Nations supplied diplomatic frameworks, sanctions instruments, and international resolutions. These roles must not be reduced to two single national armies: from 2000 to 2005, Palestinian armed groups never possessed a unified command, supply system, or identical political aims, whereas Israel supported its ground, air, naval, and intelligence arms in depth.
people: 關鍵人物並未形成一條統一指揮鏈。亞西爾·阿拉法特以巴勒斯坦民族權威機構主席及巴勒斯坦解放組織領袖身份制定政治方向，卻不直接指揮每一個武裝小組；二〇〇〇至二〇〇一年間的以色列總理是埃胡德·巴拉克，二〇〇一年後由阿里爾·沙龍接任。軍方最高層則先後由沙烏爾·莫法茲、湯米·坦與丹尼·亞通主持總參謀部。哈瑪斯方面，政治局長哈立德·馬沙爾多在敘利亞境內運作，艾哈邁德·亞辛長期坐鎮加薩，其伊茲·丁·卡桑旅與伊斯蘭聖戰組織同樣採分散式小組指揮。法塔赫武裝則同時面對以色列、哈瑪斯及自身內部派系競爭，二〇〇二年三月克薩卡爾口岸之戰最能顯示這條裂痕。馬哈茂德·阿巴斯於二〇〇三年出任總理、二〇〇五年當選主席。真正影響地面結果的，還包括各地檢查站指揮官、基層突擊隊長、空中任務協調員與維修後勤人員；他們對街巷、屋頂射界、隧道入口及道路封鎖線的熟悉程度，往往比正式作戰計畫更能決定一場遭遇戰的結果。
peopleEn: The principal figures did not form a unified chain of command. Yasser Arafat set political direction as chairman of the Palestinian National Authority and leader of the Palestine Liberation Organization, but he did not directly command every armed cell. Ehud Barak was Israeli prime minister from 2000 to 2001, after which Ariel Sharon took office. At the military level, the General Staff was led successively by Shaul Mofaz, Tommy Tan, and Danny Yatom. Within Hamas, Political Bureau leader Khaled Mashal operated largely from Syria, while Ahmed Yassin remained based in Gaza; the Izz al-Din al-Qassam Brigades and the Palestinian Islamic Jihad likewise relied on dispersed small-unit command. Fatah-linked forces confronted Israel, Hamas, and factional rivals at the same time, and the fighting at the Qasqar crossing in March 2002 exposed that divide most clearly. Mahmoud Abbas became prime minister in 2003 and president in 2005. The men who most directly shaped ground outcomes were local checkpoint commanders, assault-team leaders, air-task coordinators, and maintenance personnel; their familiarity with alleys, rooftop fields of fire, tunnel entrances, and blocked roads often mattered more than formal campaign plans.
kits: 以色列方面具備完整制式化後勤：步兵以五點五六乘四十五毫米M16A2與CAR-15為核心，另有FN FAL七點六二乘五十一毫米步槍、烏茲手槍及IWI內格夫五點五六毫米武器；支援火力包括MAG 58、M60與勃朗寧M二機槍、四零毫米M203榴彈發射器及M252八一毫米迫擊砲。裝甲與支援車包括Merkava第二型及第三型主力坦克、Centurion與M60 Patton坦克、M113裝甲運兵車、BGM-71拖式反裝甲飛彈、M109A2自行榴彈砲、M270多管火箭砲、D9與Puma工程車。航空裝備包括AH-1 Cobra、AH-64A Apache、UH-60黑鷹直升機及IAI RQ-5 Hunter無人機。巴勒斯坦武裝則混合使用AK-47、AKM、RPK、FN FAL、DShK十二點七毫米重機槍、PKM七點六二毫米機槍、RPG-7與RPG-2反裝甲武器、9-PM八二毫米迫擊砲，以及配備DShK或PKM的Toyota Land Cruiser與Hilux技術車；另使用火箭彈和爆炸物攻擊載具。常見彈藥口徑包括七點六二乘三十九毫米、七點六二乘五十一毫米、五點五六乘四十五毫米與十二點七乘九十九毫米。這些型號在二〇〇〇年以前均已存在並投入實戰，差別主要在後勤體系：以色列能集中維修、補充與替換零件，巴勒斯坦各支武裝則多依賴本地庫存、跨境取得及臨時維修，導致火力密度與持續作戰能力差距逐漸拉大。
kitsEn: Israel possessed a fully standardized logistics system. Infantry centered on the 5.56×45mm M16A2 and CAR-15, supplemented by the FN FAL 7.62×51mm rifle, Uzi submachine gun, and IWI Negev 5.56mm weapon. Support weapons included the MAG 58, M60, Browning M2 machine gun, 40mm M203 grenade launcher, and M252 81mm mortar. Armored and support vehicles included Merkava Mk II and Mk III main battle tanks, Centurion and M60 Patton tanks, M113 armored personnel carriers, BGM-71 tow anti-tank missiles, M109A2 self-propelled howitzers, M270 multiple rocket launchers, and D9 and Puma engineering vehicles. Aviation assets included AH-1 Cobra and AH-64A Apache helicopters, UH-60 Black Hawks, and IAI RQ-5 Hunter unmanned aircraft. Palestinian forces used mixed inventories of AK-47, AKM, RPK, FN FAL, DShK 12.7mm heavy machine guns, PKM 7.62mm machine guns, RPG-7 and RPG-2 anti-tank weapons, 9-PM 82mm mortars, and Toyota Land Cruiser or Hilux technicals carrying DShK or PKM machine guns; they also employed rockets and explosive-laden attack vehicles. Common ammunition calibers included 7.62×39mm, 7.62×51mm, 5.56×45mm, and 12.7×99mm. Every model named here existed and had entered operational use before 2000. The decisive difference lay in logistics: Israel could concentrate maintenance, resupply, and parts replacement, whereas Palestinian groups relied on local stocks, cross-border acquisition, and improvised repair, widening the gap in firepower density and endurance.
tactics: 最初數月，聖殿山與耶路撒冷老城的對峙以石塊、汽油瓶、狙擊和零星槍擊為主，巴勒斯坦警察一度試圖在聖殿山入口維持秩序，以軍則使用催淚瓦斯、實彈射擊、逮捕與武裝巡邏控制局面。街頭衝突升級後，哈瑪斯及法塔赫武裝把小組分散、伏擊、狙擊、反戰車火箭、地雷或爆炸物路障、迫擊砲與火箭射擊結合起來，使公路巡邏和固定檢查站成為主要風險點；以軍則由單純守線轉向搜索、逮捕、縱深突擊、空地協同射擊與封鎖區作戰。二〇〇二年「冬雨行動」及「防禦盾牌行動」中，裝甲步兵由傑寧、圖勒卡姆、貝特萊希姆等方向進入城區，巡邏隊在狹窄街巷中屢遭伏擊，「傑寧行動」更將突擊、搜索、清障與空軍支援集中於數日內。三月中旬克薩卡爾之戰則是巴勒斯坦內戰，哈瑪斯武裝沿拉法通往開羅的道路推進，與法塔赫轄下的武裝及安全部隊正面交戰。五月「三百號行動」中，加薩船隊自港口向地中海北上，以色列海軍從側翼追蹤，登船組接管其中一艘船，海軍直升機同時維持空中掩護；隨後「夏雨行動」把空軍、炮兵與地面突擊轉向加薩南部。二〇〇三年後，以軍加強以情報定位指揮官、空中定點攻擊、沿海封鎖和突擊地道入口的作法；二〇〇四年拉法行動與「秋雲行動」則針對邊境通道、海路與地下補給網展開。到二〇〇五年撤離加薩時，地面滲透、伏擊與遠程火力仍是雙方的主要互動方式。
tacticsEn: During the first months, confrontations around the Temple Mount and the Old City of Jerusalem centered on stones, Molotov cocktails, snipers, and sporadic gunfire. Palestinian police briefly attempted to maintain order at the Temple Mount entrance, while Israel relied on tear gas, live fire, arrests, and armed patrols. Once street fighting spread, Hamas and Fatah fighters combined dispersed small teams, ambushes, sniper fire, anti-tank rockets, mines or explosive road obstructions, mortars, and rocket fire, turning road patrols and fixed checkpoints into principal targets. Israel shifted from simply holding a line to searches, arrests, depth raids, joint air-ground fires, and operations inside sealed areas. In Operation Winter Rains and Operation Defensive Shield in 2002, armored infantry entered dense urban areas from directions including Jenin, Tulkarm, and Bethlehem, while patrols in narrow streets repeatedly came under ambush. Operation Jenin concentrated raids, searches, route clearance, and air support into several days. The fighting at Qasqar in mid-March was a Palestinian civil conflict, with Hamas fighters advancing along the road from Rafah toward Cairo and clashing with Fatah-linked forces and security units. During Operation No. 300 in May, a convoy left Gaza and moved north through the Mediterranean while Israeli naval forces tracked it from the side; boarding teams took one vessel under helicopter cover. Operation Summer Rains then redirected air, artillery, and ground assault toward southern Gaza. From 2003 onward, Israel expanded intelligence-led attacks on commanders, air strikes against fixed targets, coastal interdiction, and raids on tunnel entrances. The Rafah operation and Operation Autumn Clouds in 2004 concentrated on border crossings, maritime routes, and underground supply networks. By the 2005 Gaza disengagement, infiltration, ambush, and long-range fire remained the principal forms of contact.
data: 可核實的時間軸由二〇〇〇年九月二十八日沙龍進入聖殿山與哈拉姆·沙里夫引發的武裝衝突開始；十月一日衝突擴至多座西岸城市，十月七日《奧斯陸第二協議》仍在華盛頓簽署。二〇〇一年初，哈瑪斯成立以「阿克薩旅」為名的武裝組織，巴勒斯坦伊斯蘭聖戰組織與法塔赫也加速整編。二〇〇二年二月十九日以軍展開「冬雨行動」，三月中旬爆發克薩卡爾之戰，三月二十九日啟動「防禦盾牌行動」，四月一日至二日進入傑寧，五月十四日至十六日執行「三百號行動」，五月二十一日再發動「夏雨行動」。二〇〇三年八月二十八日至三十日「黑暗行動」進入加薩；二〇〇四年五月八日至十七日發動拉法行動，同年九月進行「秋雲行動」。二〇〇五年二月八日召開沙姆沙伊赫峰會，三月二十九日至三十日舉行開羅峰會，八月十五日至二十二日完成單方面撤離加薩的軍事階段；二〇〇六年一月哈瑪斯在巴勒斯坦地方選舉勝出，標誌衝突後政治格局的改變。地理上，北線由傑寧、胡瓦爾、圖勒卡姆、卡爾基利亞通往耶路撒冷，中路集中於納布盧斯、拉姆安拉與貝特萊希姆；南線則是加薩城、代爾拜萊赫與拉法。以軍由北方、中部及南方司令部分區運作，裝甲和航空單位從內瓦蒂姆、哈采林等基地向加薩集結，西部公路線則依賴檢查站與封鎖路段推進。巴勒斯坦方面分屬總統安全部隊、國家安全部隊及加薩安全部隊，武器供應部分經由拉法地下通道和地中海船運進入。各方傷亡名單與統計口徑互相衝突，因此本實錄不列出無法交叉核驗的精確傷亡總數。
dataEn: The verifiable chronology began with the armed clashes triggered by Ariel Sharon's entry into the Temple Mount and al-Haram al-Sharif on September 28, 2000. Fighting spread to several West Bank cities on October 1, while the Oslo II Accord was still signed in Washington on October 7. In early 2001, Hamas formed the armed organization known as the al-Aksa Brigades, while the Palestinian Islamic Jihad and Fatah also accelerated their restructuring. Israel launched Operation Winter Rains on February 19, 2002; fighting broke out at Qasqar in mid-March; Operation Defensive Shield began on March 29; forces entered Jenin on April 1 and 2; Operation No. 300 ran from May 14 to 16; and Operation Summer Rains followed on May 21. Operation Out of Darkness entered Gaza from August 28 to 30, 2003. The Rafah operation took place from May 8 to 17, 2004, followed by Operation Autumn Clouds that September. The Sharm el-Sheikh Summit opened on February 8, 2005; the Cairo Summit met on March 29 and 30; and the military phase of the unilateral Gaza disengagement was completed between August 15 and 22. Hamas's victory in the Palestinian local elections in January 2006 marked the political realignment that followed. Geographically, the northern axis ran from Jenin through Huwwar and Tulkarm toward Qalandia and Jerusalem, while the central axis focused on Nablus, Ramallah, and Bethlehem; the southern axis was Gaza City, Deir al-Balah, and Rafah. Israel's Northern, Central, and Southern Commands divided the theater, with armored and air units massing near Gaza from bases including Nevatim and Hatzerim, while movement on western roads depended on checkpoints and blocked sections. On the Palestinian side, Presidential Security, the National Security Force, and Gaza security units remained divided, while weapons entered partly through Rafah tunnels and maritime routes. Competing casualty lists and counting methods make a precisely verified overall total impossible, so this record does not quote uncertain figures.
cause: 起義的根源不能只歸於二〇〇〇年九月的單一事件。歐斯陸協議建立了臨時安排，卻沒有解決最終地位、耶路撒冷地位、邊界、聚落安全、資源管理與巴勒斯坦建國等核心問題；二〇〇〇年七月的戴維營峰會未能形成共同文本，協議正文的空白很快轉化為街頭衝突與武裝競逐。二〇〇〇年九月二十八日沙龍以住房部長身份進入聖殿山，直接碰上巴勒斯坦警察與聚集人群的管制摩擦，隨後石塊、汽油瓶和槍火迅速擴散。另一層原因是組織競爭：巴勒斯坦民族權威機構的安全單位受到以色列安全協調機制的約束，卻缺乏對所有武裝團體的指揮權；哈瑪斯與巴勒斯坦伊斯蘭聖戰組織建立平行武裝網絡，法塔赫則以「阿克薩旅」回應，二者的街頭競爭與對以作戰同時進行。以色列在二〇〇〇年加強道路封閉、增設固定檢查站並擴大抓捕和突擊範圍；巴勒斯坦武裝隨即以路旁伏擊、火箭、迫擊砲和爆炸物攻擊回應。逮捕、突擊、火箭與反伏擊形成彼此刺激的循環，使原本可由安全安排管理的局部摩擦，最終變成跨越西岸、加薩與耶路撒冷持續五年的消耗戰。
causeEn: The uprising cannot be attributed to a single event in September 2000. The Oslo agreements created interim arrangements but did not resolve final-status questions, Jerusalem, borders, settlement security, resource management, or Palestinian statehood. The July 2000 Camp David summit failed to produce a common text, and the agreement's unresolved clauses quickly moved into street conflict and armed competition. On September 28, Ariel Sharon's entry into the Temple Mount as housing minister directly intersected with friction between Palestinian police, who were attempting to control a crowd, and Israeli forces. Stones, Molotov cocktails, and gunfire then spread rapidly. A second cause was organizational rivalry. Palestinian National Authority security units depended on Israeli security coordination and lacked authority over every armed organization; Hamas and the Palestinian Islamic Jihad created parallel armed networks, while Fatah answered with the al-Aksa Brigades. Street competition and operations against Israel therefore proceeded at the same time. Israel intensified closures, established fixed checkpoints, and expanded arrests and raids during 2000, and Palestinian forces answered with roadside ambushes, rockets, mortars, and explosive attacks. The resulting cycle of arrests, raids, rocket fire, and counter-ambushes turned a local friction that might have been managed through security arrangements into a consuming conflict spanning the West Bank, Gaza, and Jerusalem for five years.
impact: 五年衝突改變了雙方的軍事制度。以軍在密集城區累積了小分隊突擊、裝甲與步兵協同、情報驅動定點清除、無人機持續偵察、反伏擊部署及工程開路的經驗；M270多管火箭砲、M109A2自行榴彈砲、AH-64A與AH-1等火力更常與地面突擊同步使用。約旦河西岸的障礙、道路封閉與固定防線長期化，軍方也提高預備役動員頻率。巴勒斯坦民族權威機構在二〇〇二年把數支安全力量整編為國家安全部隊，二〇〇三年又進行重組，但不同派系、指揮官與地域之間的裂痕沒有消失。哈瑪斯的戰鬥與政治組織則在持續打擊中擴張：二〇〇四年三月二十二日艾哈邁德·亞辛被武裝直升機定點攻擊身亡後，哈瑪斯仍維持其武裝與政治運作，並在二〇〇六年地方選舉成為最強勢巴勒斯坦政治力量。國際層面，二〇〇二年四國集團路線圖、二〇〇五年沙姆沙伊赫峰會及開羅峰會，把軍事隔離與政治談判重新放到同一張議程；加薩撤離則成為一次有限但實際完成的軍事安排。各方傷亡總數因來源、時間與統計分類不同而無法可靠統一，本文只記錄可核實的作戰事件，不虛列精確數字。
impactEn: Five years of conflict altered the military institutions on both sides. The IDF accumulated extensive experience in small-unit assaults, combined arms, intelligence-led targeted operations, persistent UAV surveillance, counter-ambush deployments, and engineering clearance in dense urban terrain. The M270 multiple rocket launcher, M109A2 self-propelled howitzer, AH-64A Apache, and AH-1 Cobra were used more often in direct coordination with ground raids. Barriers, road closures, and fixed defensive positions in the West Bank became long-term features, while reserve activation increased. On the Palestinian side, the Palestinian National Authority consolidated several security formations into the National Security Force in 2002 and reorganized them again in 2003, but the rifts among factions, commanders, and regions did not close. Hamas expanded its military and political organization through continued armed operations: after Ahmed Yassin was killed in a helicopter strike on March 22, 2004, Hamas maintained its military and political apparatus and became the strongest Palestinian political force in the January 2006 local elections. Internationally, the April 2002 Quartet Roadmap, the February 2005 Sharm el-Sheikh Summit, and the March 2005 Cairo Summit placed military separation and political negotiation on the same agenda, while the Gaza disengagement became a limited but genuinely completed military arrangement. Overall casualty totals cannot be reliably unified because sources, dates, and counting categories differ; this record therefore cites only verifiable operational events and does not invent exact figures.
result: 到二〇〇五年末，第二次巴勒斯坦大起義沒有產生可以單獨稱為決定性勝利的結局。以軍在西岸仍保有情報、檢查站、突擊與空地打擊能力，並在加薩完成大部分撤離後維持邊境部署；撤出加薩境內定居點及大部分地面部隊，卻沒有延伸至西岸，也沒有解決耶路撒冷、邊界或軍隊安全安排。巴勒斯坦方面，哈瑪斯憑藉武裝、基層組織與加薩經驗取得政治上升勢頭，法塔赫與巴勒斯坦民族權威機構的內部整合則更形脆弱；哈瑪斯在二〇〇六年選舉勝出，是這場起義最持久的政治後果。戰術上，以色列能以情報、封鎖和聯合火力壓制固定目標，巴勒斯坦武裝則以分散小組、伏擊、火箭、迫擊砲及地下補給維持游擊，但兩者都無法迫使對方接受完整政治方案。因此，傳統上以二〇〇五年沙姆沙伊赫峰會及加薩撤離作為大起義的軍事終點，此後仍有零星槍擊、火箭與定點攻擊。實錄的結論因此不是任何一方取得全勝，而是以軍完成加薩的有限撤離、巴勒斯坦政治力量重新排序、最終地位仍未解決；傷亡總數則因統計基礎不一，不列精確數字。
resultEn: By the end of 2005, the Second Palestinian Intifada had produced no outcome that could be described as a single decisive victory. Israel retained intelligence, checkpoint, raid, and air-ground strike capabilities in the West Bank. After completing most of the Gaza withdrawal, it maintained a border presence there; it evacuated settlements and most ground forces from Gaza, but the withdrawal did not extend to the West Bank and did not resolve Jerusalem, borders, or military-security arrangements. On the Palestinian side, Hamas gained political momentum through its armed organization, grassroots networks, and experience in Gaza, while Fatah and the Palestinian National Authority became more internally fragmented. Hamas's electoral victory in 2006 was the most durable political consequence of the uprising. Tactically, Israel could suppress fixed targets through intelligence, blockade, and combined fires, while Palestinian groups sustained guerrilla activity through dispersed cells, ambushes, rockets, mortars, and underground supply routes; neither side, however, could compel the other to accept a complete political settlement. The conventional military endpoint of the Intifada is therefore placed at the 2005 Sharm el-Sheikh Summit and Gaza disengagement, although isolated gunfire, rocket fire, and targeted attacks continued afterward. The conclusion is not a victory for either side, but a limited Israeli withdrawal from Gaza, a reorganization of Palestinian political power, and the continuing absence of a final-status settlement. Overall casualty totals are omitted because their counting bases are inconsistent.
